conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (It’s that family of three I saw earlier...)

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (They seem to be locals returning from a trip. They probably know a bit about what’s going on in Yuntai. I could use this chance to ask about the city.)

choices.text: Thank you for telling me all this.

conversations.name: The boy
conversations.content: Dad! Look! This arm can bend all the way back! So cool!

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (That’s exactly what he said in the dream… and that puppet in his hand—it reminds me of what he turned into.)

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: (No point overthinking it. Let’s try talking to them.)

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: I’ve never seen a puppet like that before. May I ask where you got it?

conversations.name: The boy
conversations.content: Someone gave it to me! I took it with me before we left for the trip!

conversations.name: Dad
conversations.content: Make sure you keep it safe this time. Don’t forget it at the hotel again.

conversations.name: Mom
conversations.content: Sigh… I really didn’t want him to take that puppet. Those people in cloaks were just too weird.

conversations.name: Veris
conversations.content: People in cloaks?

conversations.name: Mom
conversations.content: One day after school, we ran into them handing out free merch on the street. He really liked one of the puppets. I didn’t want to take it, but he kept begging, and now he won’t go anywhere without it.
About this "Troupe Elysium"—would you mind sharing what you know about them?
Sorry to bother you, but may I ask what festival you were talking about earlier?
Don’t worry about it, sweetie—you’re not from Yuntai, are you?
Oh dear, kids your age really do love mysterious groups like that, huh~
Hehe~ I used to be into that kind of thing back in college too. I even joined a local folklore club—ended up meeting this boy’s father thanks to that. Kinda romantic, right?
...... (blushing)
Hahaha! Dad's embarrassed again!
(What a lively family.)

But honestly, I don’t know that much about the troupe itself. I’ve seen them around, handing out merch and giving talks on the street, but all the members I’ve come across were wearing masks and those long robes with hoods.
They looked super suspicious. If their flyers hadn’t said they were performing at this year’s Qiqiao Festival, I’d honestly have thought they were some weird cult sneaking into the city.
You don’t know? It’s the Qiqiao Festival—held in Yuntai every two years! It’s one of our city’s biggest celebrations. There are all sorts of fun events and tons of traditional performances.
It’s super fun! We’re getting back just in time—the opening ceremony is tomorrow!
Right, I think this flight’s supposed to land around 8 p.m. Still about an hour to go.
(Qiqiao… I think I’ve heard of it. Isn’t it an astrology-related festival? We don’t celebrate it where I’m from.)
I think I’ve heard of Qiqiao before. Is there a tradition of star worship here in Yuntai?
Star worship?

Oh, that part’s not really practiced anymore~ But there are still a lot of people who worship Xi Mu. The festival still keeps the old “craft competitions,” which is probably how strange groups like Troupe Elysium get a chance to perform.
Most of the outside groups that compete in the festival don’t cause any trouble, historically speaking.
(Xi Mu? Craft duels? I want to ask more, but I’ve already kept them long enough. Better leave it here for now.)
If that were the case, I’m sure the authorities would’ve stepped in by now.
No, ma’am. I’m here on a friend’s invitation. I didn’t even know the festival was happening.

Oh, then you’re in luck! It’s the perfect time to visit. Hope you have a great time here! Just so you know—Yuntai always goes into lockdown for the three days of the festival. Did your friend mention that to you?
What?
They didn’t? Then make sure you stay close to your friend, okay? There’s been some unrest during past festivals, and things have felt especially tense these past few years. Please be careful.
Thank you—I will.

conversations.name: Mom
conversations.content: Yeah, maybe starting about half a month ago, there were folks showing up in Yuntai calling themselves the “Troupe Elysium.”
They said they were performing at this year’s festival, and started promoting themselves all over the city.
